verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents its own event-driven automation in two places. Configured webhooks fire on recorded events such as subscription_cancelled, and Dunning sends reminder emails and schedules payment retries automatically after payment failures, with Smart retry acting on hard versus soft declines. However, the evidence shows no general user-defined rules engine for creating custom event-to-action logic, so only narrow, fixed automations are evidenced. Missing for 10: a general configurable rule/workflow builder (conditions plus arbitrary actions), documentation of rule definition and customization depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: If webhooks are configured in Chargebee, events trigger those webhooks.
With Chargebee's Dunning feature, you can send email reminders to your customers asking them to update payment details and schedule payment retries at intervals to ensure revenue can be recovered.
Chargebee's Smart retry logic retries payments at dynamic intervals based on the type of gateway transaction errors, and it acts on the hard or soft declines accordingly.
